name: t3-stress-load-tests
description: Load and stress tests for microservices architecture

scripts.test:url-k8s-rest: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://$(minikube ip):30000 -e PROTOCOL=rest k6/url-shortener-stress.js
scripts.test:url-k8s-grpc: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://$(minikube ip):30000 -e PROTOCOL=grpc k6/url-shortener-stress.js
scripts.test:qr-k8s-rest: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://$(minikube ip):30000 -e PROTOCOL=rest k6/qr-generator-stress.js
scripts.test:qr-k8s-grpc: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://$(minikube ip):30000 -e PROTOCOL=grpc k6/qr-generator-stress.js
scripts.test:combined-k8s-rest: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://$(minikube ip):30000 -e PROTOCOL=rest k6/combined-stress.js
scripts.test:combined-k8s-grpc: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://$(minikube ip):30000 -e PROTOCOL=grpc k6/combined-stress.js
scripts.test:all-local: npm run test:url-rest && npm run test:url-grpc && npm run test:qr-rest && npm run test:qr-grpc && npm run test:combined-rest && npm run test:combined-grpc
scripts.test:compare-protocols:
echo '=== Testing REST ===' && npm run test:combined-rest && echo '
=== Testing gRPC ===' && npm run test:combined-grpc
